shortDescription: Bitcoin’s latest selloff is testing the resolve of committed cryptocurrency investors, with prices moving toward their lowest levels of the year as a succession of setbacks weakens major sources of demand, Bloomberg reported.

title: Crypto Selloff Tests Traders’ Resolve as Prices Approach Yearly Lows
